Note: “Radio English” and “Radio Spanish” are my own edits, largely based on the version featured in Dangerous: The Short Films. They aren’t the genuine edits but serve as placeholders until the real ones eventually surface.

The actual edits have never leaked. The poorly done versions circulating on YouTube and within the community are fakes, based on the description that claims that the true edits omit the verses entirely. Over the years, there have been conflicting reports about what the real edits actually sound like. We don’t know for certain but if they really cut out the verses, they’re bound to be awful.

The Roger Sanchez Mixes were produced in 1993/1994 for the cancelled Dangerous single release, and later issued in 1997 as the b-side to Blood on the Dance Floor – ironically, a Dangerous outtake itself. I’ve included them here because, in my opinion, they belong to this era, alongside the rare Billie Jean remixes that may have been intended for the single but only appeared once on a limited 1994 promo EP after the cancellation of the single. MJ was clearly disappointed that Dangerous was never released as a proper single, and that he had to recycle his video concept years later for You Rock My World. I see this specially curated single release as a tribute to him.
